name: Kubernetes environment check
description: Compare Kubernetes workload environments with an Excel baseline

input_file.description: Excel .xlsx baseline containing service environment values

sheet.description: Excel worksheet containing the environment matrix

header_row.description: One-based Excel row containing service names

env_name_column.description: Excel column containing exact Kubernetes ENV names; rows with a blank value are ignored

service_start_column.description: First Excel column containing per-service values

attribute_prefix.description: Only Excel attributes with this prefix are environment rows

mapping_file.description: Optional JSON mapping from Excel service columns to workload/container names

compare_values.description: Compare expected and deployed values in addition to ENV presence

extra_policy.description: How to handle deployed ENVs absent from Excel: fail, warn or ignore

ignore_extra.description: Optional comma or space separated glob patterns for extra ENVs

show_pass.description: Print every matching ENV instead of only differences
